x.description: Horizontal position of the annotation, in ten-thousandths of the image's width (0-10000), from the left.

y.description: Vertical position of the annotation, in ten-thousandths of the image's height (0-10000), from the top.

subject.description: AT-URI of the work.sequential.page, work.sequential.slice or work.sequential.strip being annotated. AppViews ignore annotations on any other record. Use the DID form (at://did:...), not a handle.

createdAt.description: The date and time the annotation was created.

main.description: A note pinned to a point on a page, slice or strip. Anyone can write one in their own repo; AppViews decide whose annotations to show, e.g. only those from the repo that owns the subject.
